# External basic mod (ImGui Direct3D 7)

Implements the Basic Mod Menu using the Dear ImGui Direct3D 7 renderer (`src/mod_base/imgui_menu_host.cpp`) with the same menu items and native actions as `demos/internal/basic-mod`:
- Weather (`Off`, `Rain`)
- FPS (`30`, `60`, `120`)
- Music volume (`Normal`, `Low`, `Mute`)
- Unlimited ammo
- Refresh Display
- Log Game State

Build target: `igi_basic_mod_menu_external` (`igi-basic-mod-external.dll`).
